why: Three `@gadget` folders on the path, `lib` first, then `tools`, then `ext`; `lib` and `tools` each hold a constructor `gadget.m`, `ext` only a method. MATLAB R2026a: the object comes from the first constructor on the path (`lib`'s), and the methods of all three folders are its methods, the one in a folder with a constructor of its own too: each call runs.
